The '''Weapons Depot''' was a large cache of weapons located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are getting reports that the thugs have already shipped off some things they found at the site. You need to track them down and retrieve what's ours. One is at the starport in Nashal and the other is at what appears to be a Rebel weapon depot.|[[Omkoo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Grave Robbers|Talus}}</ref>}}
Originally owned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was hotly contested during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been trying to get control of the weapons.<ref name="SWG:WD" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]],<ref name="SWG:GR" /> a group fighting for the independence of the [[Double Worlds]] from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]],<ref name="SWG:TLP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Talus Liberation Party|Talus}}</ref> shipped weapons, medical equipment and valuable artifacts to the weapons depot in order to obtain the support of the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:GR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Omkoo]] fought several [[TTLP soldiers]] in the depot to retrieve old artifacts stolen from an [[Aqualish gravesite]].<ref name="SWG:GR" />

Following the [[Battle of Restuss]],<ref name="SWG:C1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref><ref name="GalaxyAtWar">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66909&resource=features|text=''A Galaxy At War''}}</ref> the Rebellion lost control of the weapons depot that became the site of regular fighting between Rebel and Imperial forces. Both factions established [[Rebel Forward Base Camp (Talus)|small]] [[Imperial Forward Base Camp (Talus)|camps]] nearby to support their assaults.<ref name="SWG:C2" /><ref name="GalaxyAtWar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Weapons Depot was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:WD" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the earliest version of the game, the Weapons Depot was a Rebel "Factional NPC Base" named '''Rebel Weapons Depot'''. Groups of Imperial players could attack Rebel NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW">{{SonyCite|url=manual_detail.jsp?id=58143|text=Swaying the War}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2]]" update on [[August 1]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> the "Rebel Weapons Depot" was turned into the "Weapons Depot". It became one of the three bases that players of each faction could capture, along with the [[Weapons Development Facility|Naboo Weapons Development Facility]] and the [[Tactical Training Facility|Corellian Tactical Training Facility]].<ref name="SWG:C2" />
